messages: Elena K: Quick design review — spotted a few mismatches between the in-app help pane and the canonical docs. Opening thread to collect fixes / owners. TL;DR: terminology drift, missing deep-links, and an a11y label missing on the help icon. Sam W: Can you paste concrete examples? I glanced at the panel but didn't capture specifics. Elena K: Sure — in the embedded help we use "model profile" (header) but the docs use "model card". The panel header shows "Usage" while docs have "Usage & limits". Small but causes confusion in screenshots and support responses. Ravi P: Where does the panel text come from now? Is it rendered from the docs service or copy stored in the console repo? Maya L: It's pulled from the docs service by slug, then we take the first heading + first paragraph as the snippet. That trimming is why headings diverge. Sam W: Ok that explains the inconsistency. Two quick approaches: 1) make docs the single source of truth and adjust panel to render exact headings, or 2) keep console-side overrides with a mapping table. Elena K: I prefer (1) when it's low-cost — canonicalize the term in docs to "model card" across pages. But we need a fallback so panel links don't break if headings change. Ravi P: Also flagged an accessibility issue: the small ? icon that opens the panel doesn't have an aria-label on mobile. Screen reader announces only "button". Maya L: I'll add aria-label="Open help panel". Also propose adding a data-telemetry attr so we can see how often the panel is used: data-telemetry="help.open". Sam W: For stable crosslinks, can we add explicit anchor tokens in docs like "#help-models"? Then the panel can open /docs/models#help-models reliably. Elena K: Yep. Example link we could use in the panel: ```html Read the full docs ``` Sam W: Also recommend adding search synonyms in the docs search index: map "model profile" -> "model card" so internal lookups work during transition. Ravi P: Who should own the mapping table? Docs team sets canonical anchors; console keeps a tiny JSON synonyms file for legacy copy. I can add that to the console config. Maya L: I'll prepare a PR to the console repo with three things: aria label change, telemetry attribute, and a mapping skeleton (small JSON file + loader). @Sam W can you update docs headers and add anchor tokens? I can link to exact slugs in the PR. Sam W: On it. I'll rename headings and insert explicit anchors. Also will add a short changelog entry so Support sees the terminology shift. Elena K: Can we target a small deploy by end of next week? Also add a QA checklist for the release: 1) panel copy matches docs headings, 2) deep link opens the correct anchor, 3) screen reader announces the aria-label, 4) telemetry event fires on open. console-bot: Heads-up: /deploy-preview will run lint and axe accessibility checks on PRs. Maya L: Adding the QA checklist to the PR description now. I'll ping eng-oncall if anything flakey appears in the preview. Elena K: Thanks all :thumbsup:
